Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Garrett
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 01/27/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 140 as introduced appropriates $13,151,435 from the Education Trust Fund to Tuskegee University for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023. In addition, this bill requires at least $2,000,000 of this appropriation to be expended for the agricultural research and extension service state match.
Danny Garrett, Chair
Ways and Means Education
